methods.label: Calculate both areas
methods.explanation: A rectangle's area is its length times its width. Karl's garden has area \(20\times45=900\) square feet, while Makenna's has area \(25\times40=1000\) square feet. Since \(1000-900=100\), Makenna's garden is larger by \(100\) square feet, choice \(\text{E}\).
